game.name: Alone In The Dark (USA, Europe)(En,Fr,De,Es,It)
game.desc: Edward Carnby, the hero of Alone in the Dark on Xbox 360, finds himself lost in the heart of New York, in the centre of a park that hides many secrets... A scenario that proves to be complex and that obviously leaves room for a whole universe between reality and the supernatural, with its share of monsters and omnipresent dangers. This survival-horror is likely to make more than one player spend long nights of anguish...
